name: job-finder
description: Two launchers for the job-finder engine in a connected folder. job-finder-setup installs the engine and hands over to its setup procedure; job-finder routes everything after that (the weekly run, the company list, applying to a pasted job, interview prep) to the procedure files in the folder, which update themselves. Bump the version only when a launcher, the manifest or .mcp.json changes; the version shown in Cowork's plugin list is the only way to see whether the installed snapshot matches the repo.
